project_1.title: Inventory Management System
project_1.description: Complete stock control application for small businesses. Dashboard with KPIs, product and category CRUD, inbound/outbound movements, low stock alerts, QR code generation with scanner, and reports with charts and CSV export.

project_2.title: Chilao Terraza - Bar Restaurant Website
project_2.description: Production website for a bar restaurant. Displays products with categories, prices, and descriptions. Includes a separate admin panel to manage prices, products, and categories. Paid project currently in active use by the business.

project_3.title: Private Home
project_3.description: REST API for managing tourist accommodations of the private home type in Cuba. This backend is built with Django and Django REST Framework, and includes JWT authentication, roles, permissions, advanced filters, and interactive documentation.

project_4.title: Kanban Project
project_4.description: Allows task management and changing status as needed.

project_5.title: CryptoTracker
project_5.description: Enables viewing cryptocurrency information, current prices, etc.

project_6.title: Movies Site
project_6.description: It allows you to view information about movies or series, you can also search or mark movies or series as favorites.

project_7.title: Rock, Paper, Scissors
project_7.description: Real-time Rock, Paper, Scissors video game using web sockets.

project_8.title: GitHub Profile README Generator
project_8.description: A visual generator to create an amazing README.md for your GitHub profile.

project_9.title: DevMatch - Memory Challenge
project_9.description: A developer-themed memory card game. Match pairs of tech stack cards, build combos, and compete on the global leaderboard!

project_10.title: Background Remover
project_10.description: Allows uploading an image and obtaining a copy with the background removed.
